answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, every agent must lock $25,000 in a smart contract. Second, the agent's hardware enclave generates a unique, signed attestation. Third, the network validates this signature against the locked bond. This ensures every node is real. An attacker would face a massive cost of $25,000 per identity and 72 hours of hardware provisioning. This kernel of trust brings a new dawn to the agent economy. Like a precious pearl guarded by a thick shell, the bond protects the integrity of our whole network.
